excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经开始围捕目标并把他们藏到隐蔽的地方。一旦有击毁，就策划一些事件分散当地政府的注意力，掩盖我们的踪迹。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have started rounding up targets and secreting them away to secluded locations. Whenever possible, incidents are staged to distract the local authorities and cover our tracks.
